args.message: Upgrade fastjson 2.8.0 -> 2.9.4 to fix CVE-2026-31337 (unbounded recursion on deeply nested arrays)

args.head: fix/fastjson-cve-2026-31337
args.title: Upgrade fastjson to 2.9.4 to fix CVE-2026-31337
args.body:
## Summary
- payments-service pins fastjson 2.8.0, which is affected by **CVE-2026-31337** (high severity: unbounded recursion when parsing deeply nested arrays, leading to potential denial of service).
- The advisory affects `fastjson <2.9.4` (and the 3.0.x line below 3.1.0); fixed in **2.9.4** and **3.1.0**.
- This PR upgrades `fastjson==2.8.0` → `fastjson==2.9.4` in `requirements.txt` — a minimal patch bump on the 2.x line that avoids jumping to the 3.x major rewrite.

## Testing
- CI run `ci-0001` on commit `c8b8ab7878` passed.

@alex — please review. Per policy, merging to main will need code-owner approval.
